reviews.text:
Above and beyond ! Came for second opinion for my dog , and suddenly ended with all my family pets become an Artemis vet clinic patients. Started from one phone call ( sorry I cant remember the name of lady I spoke to this day ) When I explained, why I am calling and what I am expecting , she was so polite and gave me really needed support over the phone. I was booked on suitable time and with Vet I preferred to speak. As my mum came with me , she asked Piotr about her dog , and because, her dog got strong anxiety, and he is very nervous, we were offered home visit to do check up on him, what calm my mum a lot. I am very grateful for it , because it help my mum to make right decision, to do dogs teeth. As he is not easiest in traveling, and we are about 45 minutes from the practise ,vet prescribed my mum dog a tablets , to make the trip easier, what we were absolutely grateful for. As dog is highly nervous, my mum was very stressed, if they will be able to handle him at all, but Piotr make sure the dog will get the best care at clinic and they have experience with this kind of dogs. On day when we arrived, first thing we spot, was warm smile on receptionist face. She was such nice and polite to us , when we came trough door , it was really helpful as we both been stressing about all dental procedure. When we came to vet room , we were detailed explained what time op will start , and what estimated time it will end , we were explained all procedure step by step. We had phonecall about 3 pm , informing us that dog is already awake and procedure went well, and we will be able to pick him up at 5.30 , so vet can make sure he is fit to go home. When we arrived, we were explained aftercare , he even did pictures to show us, how it looked before and after , what exactly he did , and what is left to be done into future. We could ask all questions and first time from long , long time, I did not feel pressure, that I need to leave when 15 minutes of appointment clock. In my point , the most important thing is , everyone at Artemis team made my mum and her dog feel welcome and even if he is crazy and reactive no-one judge her or him. I am pleased that we choose this particular clinic and as its not closest one , it was our BEST BEST choice we could made.

From the time you open the door to Artemis clinic you will feel welcome and appreciate as pet owner, and your pet will receive right treatment and right care. As a dog owner I could not say enough thank you for your hard work and passion you gave to this place.
Amazing vet , who takes care of my cats very well!!!
Started good but costs added to quote and extra costs

This vets service has been exceptional! During such a hard time for our family they were able to reassure us every step of the way, going above and beyond for our beloved pet Keasha who sadly got her angel wings. I couldn’t recommend them more! A big thank you to the whole team especially Dr. Piotr and the lovely veterinary nurse that accompanies him. Many thanks the Cheshire family x

Great service. Great prices. Couldn't ask for a more professional service at such a great cost.
Would 100% recommend

My heart is shattered in a thousand pieces but the way you all showed such kindness and empathy towards Lucy and myself made it a little bit easier even offering her a piece of chocolate a final forbidden treat was so thoughtful. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for making it a little easier. Xxx

A trustworthy vet for your cherished pet. My senior cat has thrived significantly under Artemis Veterinary Clinic's outstanding care and professionalism. Branca and her team genuinely care for both animals and people; they are especially helpful considering my limited mobility. An absolute gem 😺💖 …
Thanks for taking the time to leave us a review. We’re glad you enjoyed your visit!
Highly recommend Elana for nutritional advice, very knowledgeable and caring. Thank you, Mav is coming along beautifully ☺️

Excellent service and a highly professional and knowledgeable team. I would especially like to highlight Dr Branca, who not only demonstrated great veterinary knowledge and professionalism, but was also incredibly kind, gentle and understanding.
It was particularly important to me that she speaks Spanish, Portuguese and English, as my limited English can sometimes make communication difficult. Thanks to her, I was able to explain my pet’s situation clearly and feel truly understood and supported throughout the entire process. You can clearly see the respect, dedication and genuine love she has for animals. Without hesitation, I would highly recommend this veterinary practice, and especially Dr Branca. An excellent professional and a truly wonderful person. ❤️
Absolutely fabulous treatment.  A long conversation regarding medication and treatment for an old girl.  Really appreciated

Fantastic service they fitted us in straight away after my dog was bitten , the vet was brilliant with my dog and operated on him straight away  . Such a warm friendly service start to finish would highly recommend. Thank you Artemis
Very happy with my first visit to the new owners. Did not feel rushed & vet was lovely with my old boy.

My Golden Retriever Klaus was very poorly due to a hot spot on his cheek. His temp was 41, not eating, hardly moving and oh wow these lovely ladies at Artemis were absolutely wonderful!! Very professional and very caring!  Within 3 days he’s playing with his ball, eating (which he loves) and generally his beautiful self again. Can’t thank them enough!
Can’t believe we have you on our doorstep.
I’m one very happy customer!
The caring and sensitive way the vet dealt with my cat’s neutering was really appreciated.  Very happy with the service.  Recommended.
Fantastic service my cat received, very patient and caring. Highly recommend!
helped with my cats urinary issues
Was really kind and made my bunny feel comfortable, he's usually very wary, so thank you
Very helpful with my cat, thank you so much
